premise: A knight in his thirties serving a minor lord on the border. Decent with a sword, nothing special.

draft.premise: A knight in his thirties serving a minor lord on the border. Decent with a sword, nothing special.

world.title: The Border Knight
world.era: High Medieval borderlands: steel swords, chainmail, and horse-travel

rules.text: Magic and the supernatural do not exist; the physical laws of nature are absolute.
A knight is bound by holy oath to serve their lord, and breaking fealty brings absolute ruin.
Wounds fester easily and diseases kill; there are no magical cures, only basic herbalism and amputations.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.culture: Feudal borderland culture, focused on hard labor, duty, and keeping watch against raids.

nature: The seasons are harsh on the border, with long, damp winters that rot crops and freeze patrols.

travel.description: Riders on horseback carry messages. A broken bridge or muddy road can isolate a keep for days.

medicine.healing: Basic stitching and hot iron cauterization. A deep gut wound is a slow death sentence.

laws.text: The local lord holds absolute power of high and low justice over his domain.

norms: Desertion or cowardice on the border is considered monstrous.
Frugality and simple, sturdy armor are normal and respected.

places.name: Oswald Keep
places.description: A drafty stone fortress weathered by the northern wind, standing watch over the border lands.

places.name: The Garrison Yard
places.description: A muddy training yard within the keep's wooden palisade, smelling of horse dung and wet hay.

places.name: Lowbridge Village
places.description: A cluster of thatched peasant huts huddled near a strategic river crossing.

places.name: The Wild Woods
places.description: A dense, ancient forest stretching past the border, unclaimed by any king and home to outlaws.

factions.name: House Oswald
factions.description: A minor noble house tasked with holding this barren stretch of the realm's frontier.

factions.name: The Red Cap Bandits
factions.description: A ruthless gang of outlaws and deserters who raid isolated farms along the border.

npcs.name: Lord Oswald
npcs.description: An aging, stern frontier lord who values duty and order above all else.
npcs.appearance: Stout frame, grey beard, wearing a heavy wool cloak over plain chainmail.

wants: defend his territory with limited coin

npcs.name: Ser Rodrick
npcs.description: A cynical veteran knight who has spent twenty years on these borders and expects little from life.
npcs.appearance: Broad shoulders, a face scarred by old blade-cuts, and tired dark eyes.

wants: keep his men alive on patrols

npcs.name: Karl One-Eye
npcs.description: The brutal leader of the Red Cap Bandits, known for his cunning and lack of mercy.
npcs.appearance: Tall, lean, wearing a leather eyepatch and a stained red cap.

wants: pillage Lowbridge Village without getting cornered by Oswald's knights

clocks.name: The Red Cap Raid
steps: Bandit scouts are spotted in the forest fringes near Lowbridge Village.
An outlying barn is burned in the night as the bandits gather.
The Red Cap Bandits launch a full-scale raid to sack Lowbridge Village.

threads.title: Defending the Border
threads.stakes: The lives of the villagers and the survival of House Oswald's hold.

mysteries.question: Who is leaking the garrison's patrol routes to the Red Cap Bandits?
mysteries.answer: Berthold, a disgruntled guard in the keep, is being bribed by Karl One-Eye to leave schedules in a hollow tree.
clues: A map with the exact times of the knight patrols was found on a captured bandit scout.
Berthold has been seen spending heavy silver coins at the village tavern far beyond a guard's pay.

known_facts: The Red Cap Bandits have grown bolder since winter began.
House Oswald lacks the coin to hire mercenaries, leaving the defense entirely to the local garrison.

positions: studying a crude parchment map on the long oak table
standing by the hearth, warming his hands
props: a half-empty pitcher of small beer
a map of the southern borderlands
opening.situation: Lord Oswald has summoned you and Ser Rodrick into the drafty great hall to address reports of outlaws moving near Lowbridge Village.

world.summary: Ser Thomas, a plain-skilled border knight, must defend his lord's modest lands from a growing outlaw threat. As the Red Cap Bandits prepare a raid, Thomas must rally the garrison, patrol the damp woods, and root out a suspected traitor in their midst.

character.name: Ser Thomas
character.description: A quiet, weathered knight in his thirties who knows his duty and does it without complaint.
character.appearance: An average, unassuming build, dark brown hair cut short, wearing a faded green surcoat over simple steel chainmail.

skills.name: Swordsmanship
skills.notes: Decent with an iron blade, though no match for a true champion.

skills.name: Horsemanship
skills.notes: Capable of riding in formation and handling long, exhausting patrols.

skills.name: Shield-work
skills.notes: Trained to keep a wooden shield between himself and incoming blows.

traits.name: Duty-Bound
traits.description: He takes his knightly oath seriously, earning him the respect of his lord.

traits.name: Patrol Weariness
traits.description: Years of riding in cold rain have left him with stiff joints that ache on damp mornings.

loves: the warmth of the barracks hearth
fears: failing his oath and dishonoring his name

items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: A simple, well-balanced arming sword showing signs of regular sharpening.

items.name: Weathered Chainmail
items.description: A sturdy suit of iron mail links, worn over a padded gambeson.

items.name: Wooden Shield
items.description: A heater-style shield painted with the fading oak leaf of House Oswald.

items.name: Patrol Horse
items.description: A reliable, short-tempered gelding suited for rough terrain.

character.title: Ser

connections.name: Lord Oswald
connections.note: Thomas has served him faithfully for nearly a decade.

backstory: Thomas was knighted after defending a supply wagon during a border skirmish in his twenties.
He has spent his entire knightly career in service to House Oswald, patrolling the same muddy forests.
